text:
Nina (Finance): Heads up — customer BeaconOps pinged support about a ~100k embed spike billed for 2026-04-02 11:00-12:00 UTC. They want an explanation and possible credit.
Sam (Eng-Infra): I'll check ingestion and proxy logs. Can you paste the exact invoice line or query you pulled?
Nina (Finance): quick ledger extract:
```
hour, embed_units
2026-04-02T11:00Z, 156700
2026-04-02T12:00Z, 4,200
```
Normally they are ~50-60k per hour. This looks like an extra ~100k.
Priya (Eng-SRE): deploy-bot, any proxy or gateway changes around 11:00?
deploy-bot: Deploy event: gateway-reload v3.14 applied in eu-west-1 at 2026-04-02T10:59:58Z by sam.ops
Sam (Eng-Infra): looking at gateway logs, seeing repeated POSTs with identical batch_id from gateway-1 to ingest-4 between 10:59:59 and 11:03:10. Example:
```
[2026-04-02T11:00:02Z] gateway-1 INFO batch_id=zz9a1 sent_count=1024
[2026-04-02T11:00:02Z] ingest-4 WARN batch_id=zz9a1 duplicate_batch detected
```
Priya (Eng-SRE): checking checksums — unique embed rows 78,300 in that window but ledger shows 156,700 -> exact 2x duplication.
Nina (Finance): So the billed quantity doubled. We should prepare a credit for the difference. Any idea on cause?
Sam (Eng-Infra): root cause: graceful shutdown race in gateway v3.14 where in-flight batches were retried without idempotency because ack handshake closed early. Patch is straightforward: enforce idempotency key on gateway resend and add backpressure during restart.
Priya (Eng-SRE): mitigation: will run dedupe backfill job to reconcile ledger -> ETA 1.5h. Will also pause nightly billing export for affected invoice window until reconciliation completes.
Diego (Support): I'll let BeaconOps know we're investigating and that we'll follow up with a credit estimate.
Nina (Finance): estimate credit units = 156,700 - 78,300 = 78,400 units. Contract rate for BeaconOps = $0.0039 per embed unit. 78,400 * 0.0039 = $305.76.
Ava (Finance-Lead): Approve provisional credit up to $320 for customer communications. Final to be reconciled after backfill. Please attach ops RCA when issuing memo.
Sam (Eng-Infra): backfill done — ledger shows corrected hour count 78,302. Difference 78,398 units.
Nina (Finance): creating credit memo: 78,398 units @ $0.0039 = $305.9522 -> round to $305.95. Draft customer note:
"We observed duplicated ingestion during a gateway rolling reload which resulted in overstated embed usage for your account between 11:00-11:04 UTC on 2026-04-02. We've corrected the ledger and issued a credit of $305.95. We deployed a fix to ensure idempotent retries during gateway restarts. Sorry for the inconvenience."
Diego (Support): BeaconOps replied: "Thanks, please apply credit and confirm it appears on next invoice." They also asked if there's any risk of recurrence.
Priya (Eng-SRE): added automated test for graceful restart and deployed config to block concurrent resend path. Residual risk low; we'll monitor next 48h and alert if any regen.
Ava (Finance-Lead): Final sign-off for $305.95 credit. Mark as operational adjustment, non-recurring. Link internal incident INC-2026-522 in memo.
Nina (Finance): applied credit, updated billing queue, notified Support to confirm with customer. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
